requirement: A 6-second clip transcribes in under 30 seconds on a 4-core laptop with the model cached.
measure: Measured 10 s on the VPS browser, 2026-11-01.

requirement: The tab must survive files up to the device memory limit and fail with a clear message beyond it; no artificial cap is imposed.
measure: Ceiling to be measured per device class; recorded as an OQ until measured.

requirement: Runs on current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari with WebAssembly; WebGPU is optional and unused at MVP.
measure: Verified on Chromium; other engines not yet verified — recorded as a gap.

requirement: The deployed build shows its version and keeps a changelog; the static host serves hashed assets immutably.
measure: Version visible in the footer; changelog per release.

requirement: Client failures produce a structured console error with stage and cause; no analytics or telemetry is sent anywhere.
measure: Console-only by design; verified by the zero-external-requests check.

requirement: CSP restricts to self, wasm-unsafe-eval and blob workers; no third-party origins are contacted.
measure: Header verified; external request count zero.

requirement: Interactive targets are at least 44 px, focus is visible, contrast meets 4.5:1 for body text, and progress is announced via aria-live.
measure: Checked in the build review; formal audit pending.
